notes: 3D flip card. Front: title + subtitle + arrow. Back: title + description + CTA. Trigger: hover (default), click (JS). Reduced: no animation, instant swap. Textonly: pipeline routes to CardReveal molecule — maps title/subtitle/description/href/linkLabel to CardReveal items. Section collects all FlipCard JSON items into one CardReveal.

href.description: CTA link URL on back face.

visual._description: How the card looks — stripped in textonly

frontImage.description: Background image URL for front face.

backImage.description: Background image URL for back face.

frontIcon.description: Icon slug for front face (no image).

trigger.description: Flip trigger. hover = desktop hover + mobile tap. click = tap/click only.

flip.description: Enable 3D flip. false = instant swap. Stripped in reduced. Stripped in textonly.
